snp5.2:1.1: Ajitamāṇavapucchā (1). "Kena-ssu nivuto loko, icc-āyasmā Ajito kena-ssu na-ppakāsati, ki 'ssābhilepanaṃ brūsi, kiṃ su tassa mahabbhayaṃ". || ||
snp5.2:2.1: "Avijjāya nivuto loko, Ajitā ti Bhagavā vevicchā pamādā na-ppakāsati, jappābhilepanaṃ brūmi, dukkham assa mahabbhayaṃ". || ||
snp5.2:3.1: "Savanti sabbadhī sotā, icc-āyasmā Ajito *sotānaṃ kiṃ nivāraṇaṃ,* sotānaṃ saṃvaraṃ brūhi, kena sotā pithiyyare". || ||
snp5.2:4.1: "Yāni sotāni lokasmiṃ, Ajitā ti Bhagavā sati tesaṃ nivāraṇaṃ, sotānaṃ saṃvaraṃ brūmi, paññāy' ete pithiyyare". || ||
snp5.2:5.1: "Paññā c' eva satī ca icc-āyasmā Ajito nāmarūpañ ca mārisa, etaṃ me puṭṭho pabrūhi, katth' etaṃ uparujjhati". || ||
snp5.2:6.1: "Yam etaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi, Ajita taṃ vadāmi te, yattha nāmañ ca rūpañ ca asesaṃ uparujjhati: viññāṇassa nirodhena etth' etaṃ uparujjhati". || ||
snp5.2:7.1: "Ye ca saṃkhātadhammāse, ye ca sekhā puthū idha, tesaṃ me nipako iriyaṃ puṭṭho pabrūhi mārisa". || ||
snp5.2:8.1: "Kāmesu nābhigijjheyya, manasānāvilo siyā, kusalo sabbadhammānaṃ sato bhikkhu paribbaje" ti| AJITAMĀṆAVAPUCCHĀ NIṬṬHITĀ.
